ticker: Global markets plunge amid tech stock selloff
US weighs potential ban on Chinese-made vehicles
Nvidia faces US SEC investigation over accounting practices
Bitcoin slides significantly as crypto market corrects
Trump discusses trade deals and offshore data center taxes

articles.headline: Global Markets Hit by Severe Tech and Asset Selloff
articles.brief: Global financial markets experienced a snowballing selloff as investors dumped tech stocks and sought refuge in safe-haven assets, with Treasury yields and bullion prices also reacting heavily.

articles.headline: Nvidia Under Investigation by SEC Over Accounting Practices
articles.brief: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has launched an investigation into Nvidia's financial disclosures and accounting practices, focusing on geographic revenue reporting and overseas links.

articles.headline: US Considers Total Ban on Chinese Vehicles
articles.brief: The United States is reportedly considering a sweeping ban on Chinese-manufactured cars before the end of the year, driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions and national security concerns.

articles.headline: SpaceX's Cursor Phasing Out Chinese AI Models
articles.brief: SpaceX-linked entity Cursor is weighing the removal of Chinese artificial intelligence models from its systems due to rising geopolitical risks and strict technological boundaries.

articles.headline: Trump Warns Tech Firms Over Offshore AI Data Centers
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump has warned domestic technology corporations that they will face severe taxation if they choose to build critical artificial intelligence data centers overseas.

articles.headline: India Cyber Agency Warns of Unauthorized Payment Transactions
articles.brief: India's national cybersecurity agency has issued an urgent advisory warning citizens and financial institutions regarding an increase in fraudulent and unauthorized digital payment activities.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Suggests Law to Curb Inter-Relative Marriages
articles.brief: The Supreme Court of India has formally suggested that the federal government consider introducing legislative measures to curb marriages between close relatives based on health concerns.

articles.headline: India and Japan Deepen Defense Ties with Joint Drills
articles.brief: During high-level diplomatic visits, India and Japan agreed to deepen strategic defense cooperation, which will include Japanese forces conducting live-fire military drills at Indian firing ranges.

articles.headline: Congress Proposes Four-Point Delimitation Formula
articles.brief: The Indian National Congress has proposed a comprehensive four-point formula regarding constituency delimitation, advocating for a long-term freeze and seat distribution preservation.

articles.headline: Nations Criticize Fossil Fuel Sway at UN Climate Deal
articles.brief: Delegates from Europe, Central America, and the Pacific openly criticized ongoing UN climate negotiations, accusing the oil and gas sector of exercising undue influence over the final text.

articles.headline: India Boycotts Asia Cup Presentation After Dispute
articles.brief: The Indian delegation boycotted the official post-tournament presentation ceremony after Pakistan was declared the Asia Cup champion, citing rule disputes and technical committee disagreements.

articles.headline: DGCA Issues Strict Notice to SpiceJet Over Violations
articles.brief: India's aviation regulator, the DGCA, has issued a formal warning notice to SpiceJet airlines following a series of repeated safety and operational violations.
